articles.title: Sonay Kartal's Comeback Rolls On to the Wuhan Open Semifinals
articles.summary: Britain's Sonay Kartal beat Elina Svitolina to reach the Wuhan Open semifinals in her comeback from a back injury.

articles.title: How Movie Magic Brought Rotta the Hutt and Old-School Effects to 'The Mandalorian and Grogu'
articles.summary: An effects expert revealed how 'The Mandalorian and Grogu' mixed digital animation with old-school stop-motion puppets and a redesigned Rotta the Hutt.

articles.title: Tesla Shows Off a Roadster That Can Lift Into the Air
articles.summary: Tesla unveiled its Roadster 2 sports car at a Texas event, where a demonstration car used thrusters to lift into the air.
